people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jehoshaphat
people.line: Son of Asa, king of Judah.

translations.web: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for Yahweh’s word.”
translations.bsb: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for the word of the LORD.”
translations.kjv: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.
translations.asv: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Inquire first, I pray thee, for the word of Jehovah.
